Interface ClientMessage

All Superinterfaces:
Serializable
All Known Subinterfaces:
Request, Update
All Known Implementing Classes:
CardPickedUpdate, ChooseTotemRequest, EndGameUpdate, EndTurnRequest, ErrorMessageUpdate, EventUpdate, GameResumedUpdate, GameSuspendedUpdate, GetLeaderboardRequest, JoinGameRequest, LeaderboardUpdate, PickCardRequest, PingRequest, PlaceTotemRequest, PlayerDisconnectedUpdate, PlayerJoinedUpdate, PlayerReconnectedUpdate, PongResponse, SetupGameRequest, StateChangedUpdate, TotemColorUpdate, TotemPlacedUpdate, TotemReturnedUpdate, TurnChangedUpdate
public interface ClientMessage extends Serializable
Root interface for ALL messages traveling on the network. Being empty, it acts as a "label" (Marker Interface) to ensure that only allowed objects are sent through Sockets, making them automatically Serializable.
